subject: Stakeholder alignment & commitment roadmap — ClearSky AI evaluation
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Linh Tran <linh.tran@clearsky.ai>, Alex Novak <alex.novak@cleardata.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Stakeholder alignment & commitment roadmap — ClearSky AI evaluation

Hi Linh / Alex —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery + the proposed mutual action plan (MAP) so your team has clear milestones, owners, and expected dates. I kept this intentionally tight so it can slot into procurement and your internal steering committee.

Pain we heard
- Latency spikes affecting real-time tagging for streaming ingestion (~150ms p95 currently)
- Model costs are unpredictable at scale and need a predictable SLO-based plan
- Data residency and audit logs are required for upcoming regulator review in Q4

Primary goals
- Pilot: prove stable p95 latency under production-like traffic and measure per-token cost
- Security: demonstrate audit-log integration and encryption-at-rest keywrap
- Decision: secure Exec approval for Dedicated capacity by end of September if pilot meets SLAs

Mutual Action Plan (high level)
1) Pilot kickoff & environment setup — Responsible: ClearSky (Linh) / Redwood infra lead (Ben) — Target start: 2026-07-28 — Deliverables: VPC peering, test dataset subset, initial load script

2) Baseline benchmark & tuning pass — Responsible: Redwood (Marcus) / ClearSky engineering — Target: 2026-08-04 — Deliverables: latency/cost report, recommended batching/quantization profile

3) Security & audit verification — Responsible: ClearSky security (Alex) / Redwood security (Irene) — Target: 2026-08-18 — Deliverables: audit log export, KMS integration runbook, SOC 2 evidence checklist

4) Pilot evaluation & exec pack — Responsible: ClearSky product sponsor / Redwood AE (Ben) — Target: 2026-09-10 — Deliverables: executive summary, cost projection, go/no-go recommendation

5) Contracting & capacity reservation — Responsible: ClearSky procurement / Redwood commercial — Target: 2026-09-30 — Deliverables: SOW, reserved capacity pricing, SLAs

Immediate asks for next week
- Linh: confirm list of pilot stakeholders (engineering lead, security owner, procurement point) and share IAM contact — due 2026-07-23
- Alex: can you share the compliance checklist items that require on-prem evidence vs. control-plane evidence? (I can map to our Private offering) — due 2026-07-23
- We (Redwood): will share an initial MPA draft and a small sample load script by COB 2026-07-22 (attached).

Attachments: ClearSky-MPA-draft-20260721.pdf (draft MAP), pilot-scope-appendix.xlsx (test dataset fields)

If that looks right I’ll lock the targets and send calendar invites for the kickoff. Happy to pull in our solutions engineer (Marcus) on the call next week for the benchmark planning.

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

---

Subject: Re: Stakeholder alignment & commitment roadmap — ClearSky AI evaluation

Thanks Irene — appreciate the concise plan. Confirming on our side:
- I’ll be the pilot owner and will nominate the engineering lead (name tbd) by Friday 7/23.
- Procurement will need a one-page cost summary for the pilot and reserved capacity scenarios; can Ben share a draft?
- On audit logs: we need both control-plane attestations and a downloadable event stream. Alex will outline specifics and mark items that require on-prem evidence.

Quick note: our security/compliance meeting is Thursday 7/22 at 9am PT — I’ll invite the relevant Redwood folks if that slot works for you (Irene / Marcus).

Linh
